name: 04-decoration
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.8; } .u { text-decoration: underline; } .d { text-decoration: line-through; } .o { text-decoration: overline; } .w { text-decoration: underline wavy #c00; } .dt { text-decoration: underline dotted #06c; }
html:
下划线 underline

删除线 line-through

上划线 overline

波浪线 wavy 红色

点线 dotted 蓝色
